newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal tenders to buy diesel, kerosene for February.
newsitem.headline: Nepal tenders to buy diesel, kerosene for February.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) has issued a tender to buy superior kerosene and high speed diesel for February deliveries, industry sources said on Thursday.
The tender seeks 30,000-tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur disel for February 11-20 delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
Offers are to be made on the basis of deliveries to Madras/Vizag, Madras/Haldia, Paradeep, or Paradeep/Haldia on the Indian east coast.
NOC last bought diesel and kerosene for delivery in November at $232.80 per tonne and $249.50 per tonne, respectively, on a c-and-f east coast basis.
